subject: Coordination: Lakeview procurement lanes, PO timing & MAP checkpoints
messages:
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@lakeviewhealth.org>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lakeviewhealth.org, evan.reed@lakeviewhealth.org
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP/close ask — Lakeview pilot procurement windows

Rafael —

Thanks again for yesterday's demo. Procurement asked that we put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation milestones to the legal/PO gating points. Key asks from our side:

- Firm target for MSA/DPA signature (we'd like to align around a 4–6 week cadence).
- When a PO can be issued relative to the DPA (we have an internal rule that PO must be sent after DPA countersigned).
- Evidence we can provide for the security review (SOC2, data retention language, certs).

Can you send a one-page MAP + timeline and suggested owners so we can circulate internally? Attached: our internal procurement checklist (for context).

Appreciate it —
Hannah
Hannah Li
Procurement Lead | Lakeview Health

Attachment: lakeview_procurement_checklist_20261119.pdf (pdf)
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@lakeviewhealth.org>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial MAP/close ask — Lakeview pilot procurement windows

Hannah —

Great to hear this. I put together a concise three-phase plan below that maps Evaluation -> Legal -> Procurement handoffs and suggested owners. I attached a lightweight MAP spreadsheet you can drop into your tracker. High-level notes:

Phase A — Evaluation & Pilot (weeks 0–2)
- Objective: Complete pilot success criteria and gather 1-month latency/cost metrics.
- Internal owner: Evan Reed (Lakeview) / Rafael Mendes (Redwood)
- Deliverable: Pilot sign-off doc + token/cost snapshot by week 2

Phase B — Legal & Risk (weeks 2–5)
- Objective: Execute DPA + tailored MSA redlines; security evidence handoff.
- Proposed cadence: Legal exchange + two review rounds, both sides.
- Redwood owner: Laura Bennett (Legal) — will accept standard DPA with two small data-retention redlines.

Phase C — Procurement & PO (weeks 5–7)
- Objective: Final signature (MSA + DPA) and issuance of PO; onboarding kickoff.
- Timing: We recommend Lakeview issues PO after DPA countersigned and order-form completed.

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Laura will provide a short DPA summary and the conservative redline list by Monday 11/23.
2) We (Redwood) will populate the MAP spreadsheet with dates and owners — attached.
3) Procurement can confirm their internal PO SLA so we align the PO issuance step.

Attachment: 20261120-Lakeview-MAP.xlsx (spreadsheet)

I'll kick this off with Laura and Kim.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0197
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, Hannah Li <hannah.li@lakeviewhealth.org>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -08:00
Subject: DPA summary & minimal redlines for Lakeview

Hannah / Rafael —

Following Rafael's ask, I've reviewed the standard DPA and pulled a short summary of items Lakeview may escalate. To keep the exchange tight:

- We can accept Lakeview's baseline data-retention request if scoped to the pilot dataset only (Article 3.2).
- We propose a firm retention window: 30 days of KV/cache, 90 days for logs unless otherwise requested with an SOW.
- Audit access & SOC2: we have SOC2 Type II report available; I can share the summary and points-of-contact.
- SLA credits: standard language, open to small tweaks tied to dedicated capacity (not needed for pilot).

I'll attach a 2-page DPA digest (redlines highlighted) and will be available for a targeted legal sync on Wednesday 11/25 at 10:00 PT if that works.

Attachment: Redwood-DPA-summary-2026-11.pdf (pdf)

If Lakeview wants changes beyond what I listed, please flag specifics so we can route quickly.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Hannah Li <hannah.li@lakeviewhealth.org>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lakeviewhealth.org, evan.reed@lakeviewhealth.org
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: DPA summary & minimal redlines for Lakeview

Laura —

Thanks for the clear digest. 10:00 PT on Wednesday works for our legal lead (Evan) — please send a calendar invite. A couple quick clarifications before the call:

- Retention: pilot-only retention is acceptable; we'll confirm via SOW which datasets are in-scope.
- PO timing: Procurement confirmed they will queue PO after DPA countersign; target PO issuance within 48 hours of countersign.
- SOC2: Please send the SNOC2 summary and an internal contact for security questions.

We'll review the MAP spreadsheet and bring a prioritized list of any non-starters to the call.

Best,
Hannah
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Hannah Li <hannah.li@lakeviewhealth.org>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, procurement@lakeviewhealth.org
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Action items from legal & procurement sync — next 72 hours

Quick update after today's prep:

- Laura will post the DPA digest link in our shared folder and upload the SOC2 summary by EOD Monday. Link: https://na1.docs.redwood/drive/LAKEVIEW-MAP-20261120
- I updated the MAP spreadsheet with tentative calendar slots (pilot sign-off 12/04, DPA signoff 12/17, PO issuance window 12/18–12/20).
- Kimberly will follow up on pricing tiers and confirm any order-form fields Lakeview needs populated before PO.

Please review the attached MAP and call out anything that blocks the 12/17 DPA target. If we hit that window, onboarding can start the week of 12/21.

Next: I'll send a short invite for the legal sync on 11/25 10:00 PT and a procurement touchpoint for 11/29.

Thanks —
Rafael
